name: gypsy-chat-2000
description: Old-school chat room. Static web app now, Capacitor mobile app later.

scripts.build: rm -rf www && mkdir www && cp -r index.html css js icons manifest.webmanifest sw.js www/
scripts.app:init: npm run build && npx cap add ios && npx cap add android
scripts.app:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.app:ios: npm run app:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.app:android: npm run app:sync && npx cap open android
